_comment: MEADOWS-VISUAL-PASS round 5. The Meadows realm's own look, deep-merged over data/config/art.json by world_look.gd (realm_look_path on the Meadows WorldLook). art.json's presets are shared by every realm; what only the Meadows wants lives here.
_comment_environment: Distance haze. art.json's shared #a6bccb at 0.00055 turned the far plain into a white band under every elevated Meadows view (survey 03: a 'white fog wall'); a bluer, lighter haze keeps the depth cue while the hills and groves still read at a kilometre.
